messages.author: ce7f38aed64bc5be
messages.subject: Using INLA for nonlinear model
parts: Hi, I would like to fit a model of the form y = a + b(x^c) using INLA. Is there a way to fit this model in INLA? If yes, I would be grateful if somebody could please give an example of how to fit such a model. In the data being fit, we are assuming y is normally distributed and x is a continuous covariate.

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Using INLA for nonlinear model
parts:
its almost there,

inla.doc("sigm")

otherwise, you can implement this using 'rgeneric', see

inla.doc("rgeneric")

and the linear regression example in the end
